top_signals.title: Modi Punctured as Awakened India Students Force Retreat
top_signals.summary: For much of Narendra Modi’s 12 years ruling India, he’s looked nearly unbeatable at the polls. This weekend he swiftly yielded to a group that didn’t exist a few months ago, energizing opponents who have struggled to rattle one of the nation’s most powerful leaders ever.
